newsitem.title: USA: Callon buys interests from Elf.
newsitem.headline: Callon buys interests from Elf.

text.p: Callon Petroleum Co said Tuesday it acquired offshore Alabama interests from Elf Exploration Inc, a subsidiary of Elf Aquitaine of France, for $12.5 million.
The company said that at current flow rates, it expects this acquisition to boost third quarter natural gas production by 12 percent when compared with second quarter levels.
The purchase includes working interests in areas located on the outer continental shelf in the Gulf of Mexico.
The sale was effective April 1 and is limited to depths above 4,200 feet subsea. Callon Petroleum develops and operates oil and gas properties.
